issues.claim: Party Fair of Kendall Park, 3562 NJ-27 (group D)
issues.problem: Excluded type remains in the list: 'Party Fair' is a franchised party-supplies retail brand, and the entry itself flags this ('may be an excluded franchise store'). No evidence of independent ownership was found; the store is also published with phone (732) 422-7300 and Suite 126, which the entry leaves as 'Unknown'.
issues.fix: Remove the entry, or find explicit evidence that this store is independently owned before keeping it; if kept, fill phone/suite from the directory listing.

issues.problem: Seven of the 21 eligible businesses surfaced by nine independent category searches are absent, i.e. 14/21 = 66.7% listed, below the 70% threshold. The gaps are concentrated in group B/C (dentists, salons, nail salons, auto repair), which the mapper added this revision but did not sweep completely.
issues.fix: Add the missing entries listed under coverage.missing (United Dental Group of Brunswick, Smiles By Dr. Levine, D'Bella Salon, Liberty Nails, New Star Nails & Spa, EG Auto Center, Neighborhood Roofing Co.) or explicitly hand groups B/C back to their owning mapper instead of half-covering them.

issues.claim: Four entries rest on a single aggregator listing with no other support: Montessori Children's World (12 Stults Rd), Little Learners Pre-School (1 New Rd), Home Appliance Repair Kendall Park (3616 NJ-27), Artists In Motion Dance (3562 NJ-27)
issues.problem: None could be confirmed as currently trading. Montessori Children's World does not appear under that name in the NJ DCF licensed child-care centre list; Little Learners still appears only in an apartment-community directory; 'Home Appliance Repair Kendall Park' reads like a keyword-styled lead listing; Artists In Motion is confirmed only by a third-party Waze/bio reference that another search result confuses with a Cherry Hill studio.
issues.fix: Keep flagged as unverified (as the mapper did) and do not spend triage time on them until a phone check is allowed; consider dropping Home Appliance Repair and Artists In Motion, which are the weakest.

issues.claim: Two dance studios at Town Place: The Dance Collective NJ (3570 NJ-27) and Artists In Motion (3562 NJ-27 Suite 123)
issues.problem: The landlord's 2026 leasing flyer markets a vacant 'former dance studio' unit in the same centre, so at least one of the two dance entries is probably no longer a tenant. The mapper flagged this for The Dance Collective but then also listed a second Kendall Park dance studio in the same complex.
issues.fix: Verify by phone which studio occupies/occupied the unit; most likely only one is current.

issues.claim: Licensing of multiple pare-school entries (Village Microschool, Sand Hills Christian Preschool, Sapling School, Kids First Montessori, Promissory, Montessori Connections, Milestones, ABC 123)
issues.problem: Under a literal reading of the mapper's exclusion list ('schools'), private microschools, preschools and music/tutoring schools are borderline exclusions; the mapper treats them as group D eligible without stating the rule. Not a data error, but the exclusion rule needs confirming.
issues.fix: Orchestrator to confirm that 'schools' means K-12 public/private schools and school districts, not preschools, daycares and enrichment schools; otherwise these entries fall out.

issues.claim: Suite-level details for Town Place tenants (Innovative Physical Therapy, American Dentistry, Nail Spa, Fit Kicks Martial Arts)
issues.problem: The only source is the broker flyer, which lists co-tenant names with no suite numbers or phones, and it uses the centre address 3570 Route 27 while several entries give 3562 NJ-27 for the same tenants. The complex appears dual-numbered, so this is not a contradiction, but suite detail is unverified.
issues.fix: Leave suite fields blank/Unknown rather than mixing 3562 and 3570 addresses; note that the centre is dual-numbered on Route 27.
